card.name: Words just before 'and/or' pairs
card.fires_on: Responds to a word right before a repeated or paired phrase: 'set' in 'infusion set and the infusion set', 'personal' before 'or family history', 'misuse,' before 'and addiction', 'monotherapy' before 'and adjunctive therapy'.
